Verify external scope identity, all eleven original frozen gate proofs, new backup code+tests in passed whole guards, actual installed noneditable package/runtime, and exact updater receipt before loading production Settings.
Hold operation/service/engine/cockpit/workspace/database-writer locks for the entire operation; require live process quiescence. No stale PID-cache proof, chmod of legacy locks, or queue claiming.
Create one new owned0700 post-update run directory; refuse every existing destination/run directory including partial failure artifacts.

Start only the exact admitted JVM via retained pidfd/birth/scope/own-listener proof. Use existing_store with the retained writer fd; do not call Store constructor/init/ensure_database or service APIs.

Read a full transaction export, require no running jobs, call installed Store._write_backup, validate via Store._validated_backup, compare exact domain/vector/journal values, and compare another live export; no job mutation or inference.
On success or failure independently request only owned JVM graceful stop and verify actual exit, then owned-scope quiet>=30seconds and production quiescence; any cleanup uncertainty fails.

Recheck runtime/source/installed package/update receipt/admission. Publish private600 backup-report.json with fsync only after successful validation and cleanup. Local completed status remains pending external observation.

Wait for actual controller and Linux supervisor exits plus Windows post-exit watch/receipt. Verify receipt with the same frozen attestor, require status/cleanup/no forced/no native errors, and match public private_backup_report_sha256 to the private report before building any one-job admission.

Only then set retry admission post_update_backup and post_update_backup_report paths+actual SHA values. Repeat a new backup before every later explicit job attempt; archive must be<=1hour old and current DB must still equal the archive.
